name: LXRXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Inspired by the LXR-02: its open-source sound engine (GPL-3.0) with the real FX unit and the plate reverb, the whole panel on one page, 64-step sequencer with songs, rolls and a euclidean generator, Force pads playing the voices, randomizers and the Hrtl LXR-02 DLC presets old and new. Artwork by Suns Kiefer.
